+// NotifyExit closes the global stdin reader so that an active password read
+// can restore the terminal before the program exits.
+func NotifyExit() {
+	stdinMU.Lock()
+	defer stdinMU.Unlock()
+	if closer, ok := stdin.(interface{ Close() error }); ok {
+		_ = closer.Close()
+	}
+}

+func TestNotifyExitRestoresPassword(t *testing.T) {
+	pr, pw := io.Pipe()

+	defer pw.Close()
